supersedes.reason: The JNOV MDS/DDW-4TP third-party drive basis is replaced by the INGECART IGC-DW proprietary drive-wheel family, laser navigation and full-machine CE marking described in the INGECART technical document INGETRANS_smart_technical data.html (Rev. 1, 14/09/2026). JNOV data is kept as historical reference only.

primary_source.title: Transbordo de carga sin obra civil - Propuesta tecnico-comercial P0001_2026 Rev. 1
primary_source.issuer: INGECART S.L. - Electrical & Automation Department (Gerard Gonzalez)

validation.method: Independent recomputation of every numeric statement in annexes A and B with the document's own input data

results.item: IGC-DW20 motor power from torque and speed
Base case traction margin (2 x DW20)
40 t configuration traction margin (4 x DW100)

validation.conclusion: Technical document is internally consistent; values adopted as product baseline R2 with the qualifications listed below.

product_definition.statement: INGETRANS Smart is a rail-less, battery-powered autonomous transfer platform that performs the INGETRANS reel delivery and return function without embedded running rails, without conductor line (catenary/Vahle) and without fixed power supply along the route, using INGECART IGC-DW drive and steering wheels, laser natural navigation, local station referencing and an on-board 48 V DC LiFePO4 battery.
removed_infrastructure: Embedded steel running rails and their trench/foundation
Conductor line (catenary / Vahle) with supports and current collector or festoon
Fixed three-phase feed along the route
Mechanical end stops and rail-mounted limit switches
product_definition.delivered_as: Complete machine, CE marked by INGECART as manufacturer (Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC until 2027-01-19; Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 for deliveries from 2027-01-20).

common.motor: Brushless DC servomotor, S1 continuous duty, efficiency about 0.90
common.feedback: 2,500 ppr incremental encoder on traction, absolute encoder on steering

standard_configurations.application: Euro pallet transfer, light reels, boxes; differential traction with turn on own axis
4 x 2 m platform with four-corner traction and steering: longitudinal, transverse and centre rotation
Large-format reels, dies, tooling, process equipment; speed limited by load-stability criterion

base_case.battery: 48 V 200 Ah LiFePO4 with BMS, 9.6 kWh, 80% usable = 7.68 kWh

ingetrans_reel_case_mapping.note: INGETRANS reel carrier exceeds the 3,500 kg base case (reel below 3,500 kg plus carrier tare). Standard configuration to quote for reel duty is 4 x IGC-DW20 (up to 6,000 kg total mass) or 4 x IGC-DW100 for dual heavy reels; speed 0.90 m/s for DW20, 0.43 m/s for DW100.
ingetrans_reel_case_mapping.travel_time_basis: Trapezoidal profile; rail 4.5 s ramps; Smart a = 0.30 m/s2; pick-up and drop-off 6 s each unchanged
ingetrans_reel_case_mapping.rail_advantage_threshold: Sustained cycle rates above about 60 transfers/hour with constant load and frozen layout

safety_functions.implementation: Front and rear safety laser scanners with speed- and direction-dependent protective fields
Four-side pushbuttons, dual channel, controlled stop then brake
Perimeter mechanical bumper as scanner backup
Speed monitoring on safety module with forced reduction at stations, crossings and manoeuvres
Travel inhibited while transfer in progress or load not secured

complementary_measures: Manual console with three-position enabling device
0.30 m/s limit in manual and maintenance

control_architecture.fieldbus: CANopen CiA 301 / DS 402 to drives, safe I/O
control_architecture.plant_link: Industrial Wi-Fi to plant control system (calls, confirmations, traceability)

floor_requirements.surface: Industrial concrete in good condition, no breaks or spalling in the travel lane
floor_requirements.note: Measured during technical visit; local repairs identified and quoted before commitment

civil_and_infrastructure_impact.installation_window: 2-5 days without zone shutdown versus 3-6 weeks with zone shutdown
civil_and_infrastructure_impact.qualifier: Indicative ranges for a typical Spanish installation with a 26 m route; not an offer

contradictions_with_previous_baseline.previous: JNOV TECH MDS with DDW-4TP wheels (third party, partly completed machinery)
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.current: INGECART IGC-DW20 / IGC-DW100 proprietary drive wheels; INGECART manufacturer of the complete machine
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.resolution: Adopt R2. JNOV pricing and lead time (T0+24 weeks) are no longer the product basis.

contradictions_with_previous_baseline.current: 0.90 m/s (54 m/min) with DW20 up to 3.5-6 t; 0.43 m/s with DW100 above 10 t
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.resolution: Adopt R2. Smart is now about 68% of rail INGETRANS speed instead of about 42%.

contradictions_with_previous_baseline.previous: DataMatrix / painted floor line with optical sensors, +/-0.1 mm
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.current: Laser natural navigation (+/-20 mm) plus local station reference (+/-5 mm); no floor line required
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.resolution: Adopt R2. Remove DataMatrix line from scope and prerequisites.

contradictions_with_previous_baseline.previous: One Li-ion battery per drive wheel, 600 cycles, IEC C14 230 V charger
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.current: Single 48 V 200 Ah LiFePO4 pack with BMS, 48 V / 60 A automatic opportunity charger, 230/400 V supply
18-20 weeks from order to handover including CE

contradictions_with_previous_baseline.previous: DIN 18202 table 3 line 3 (4 mm/1 m, 10 mm/4 m), slope 3%
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.current: Local deviation below +/-5 mm over 2 m, joints below 20 mm, good industrial concrete
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.resolution: Adopt R2 as commercial prerequisite; keep flatness survey in engineering.

contradictions_with_previous_baseline.previous: EtherNet/IP to JNOV ELC cabinet (PROFINET on request)
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.current: CANopen CiA 301/402 to drives, Siemens on-board PLC, industrial Wi-Fi to plant
Document states 2.47 m/s2; recomputation gives 2.74 m/s2
contradictions_with_previous_baseline.resolution: Document value is conservative; keep 2.47 m/s2 as published figure.

open_points: INGETRANS reel-carrier configuration (4 x DW20 vs 4 x DW100) to be fixed by reel matrix and carrier tare.
Interface between Smart platform deck and INGETRANS pick-up mechanism / roll-stand tracks to be engineered.
Cycle capacity for the Paige corridor to be confirmed by digital twin with 0.90 m/s and station approach at 0.30 m/s.
Paige site services (mechanical assembly block) to be re-quoted; rail installation block removed.
